title: CORAL: Learning Amyloid Fibril Ligand Docking with Cooperative Binding Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2607.17412v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A hallmark of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's is the aberrant aggregation of proteins into amyloid fibrils, and small molecules that selectively bind to these fibrils hold promise as diagnostics, imaging probes, and therapeutics. Predicting how such ligands bind to fibril targets, however, presents two fundamental challenges. First, resolved co-crystal structures of amyloid-ligand complexes are exceptionally scarce; even with recent advances in cryo-EM only a handful have been structurally characterized, making supervised training of docking models impractical for this target class. Second, amyloid fibrils present a binding mode fundamentally different from globular proteins: ligands intercalate into longitudinal cross-$\beta$ grooves and stack cooperatively along the fibril axis, a geometry that existing docking models are not designed to capture. translated_title: CORAL：通过协同结合奖励学习淀粉样蛋白纤维配体对接
translated_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等神经退行性疾病的一个标志性特征是蛋白质异常聚集形成淀粉样蛋白纤维，而能够选择性结合这些纤维的小分子有望用作诊断剂、成像探针和治疗药物。然而，预测这类配体如何与纤维靶点结合面临两个根本性挑战。其一，已解析的淀粉样蛋白-配体共晶结构极为稀缺；即便借助近年来冷冻电镜技术的进展，也仅有少数复合物得到结构表征，使得针对这类靶点进行对接模型的监督学习训练难以实现。其二，淀粉样蛋白纤维呈现出与球状蛋白截然不同的结合模式：配体嵌入纵向的交叉β凹槽并沿纤维轴协同堆叠，这种几何特征是现有对接模型所无法捕捉的。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了CORAL（COopeRat…
tldr: 针对淀粉样蛋白纤维配体对接中共晶结构极度稀缺、且配体沿纤维轴协同堆叠结合模式特殊的双重挑战，提出利用协同结合奖励来学习纤维配体对接的CORAL方法。
en_tdlr: CORAL learns amyloid fibril ligand docking using cooperative binding rewards, addressing the scarcity of co-crystal structures and fibrils' unique cooperative cross-β groove stacking binding mode.
